title: Sal Pais applauds Rossi's panel example

tellings.quote: panel one time with Sal Pais and a handful of others last two summers ago and basically I used this exact example and Sal Pais started basically clapping

plain: About two summers before this conversation, around 2023, a scientist named Salvatore Pais started clapping when a guest named Dave Rossi gave a certain physics example on a panel they shared. Rossi tells this as something he was part of, saying he "used this exact example and Sal Pais started basically clapping." He brings it up as a sign that a serious scientist backed his line of thinking.
